_comment: Phase 281, migration 078: eight new tables with six indexes; columns added to recalls (0 live rows) and invoices (0 live rows), which rewrites those tables' SQL; Massachusetts inserted into the new tax tables (one jurisdiction, one rate, three line rules); one schema_version row. (A first version also named sqlite_sequence +3; the dry run reports no change there, and the line was removed.) No existing row changes or is removed; every table not named here must not change at all.
